Papers on climate and fiscal policy and on climate finance, written for finance ministries and development banks, in four sections. The modelling and analytics work is under [Modelling and Analytics](../modelling/index.qmd).

### [1. Carbon Pricing](../policy/1-carbon-pricing.qmd)

Price production and consumption separately: a feebate on emissions intensity, a destination carbon tax through VAT, and recognition of both at the border.

- [1.1 Price Production and Consumption Separately](../policy/1-carbon-pricing/OpenEconomyCarbonPricing/index.qmd)
- [1.2 Feebates](../policy/1-carbon-pricing/FeebatesAndOutputBasedRebating/index.qmd)
- [1.3 Converting a VAT into a Destination Carbon Tax](../policy/1-carbon-pricing/CarbonConsumptionTax/index.qmd)
- [1.4 Credit the Price Signal, Not the Payment](../policy/1-carbon-pricing/IronSteelCBAM/index.qmd)
- [The Right Policy at the Wrong Time](../policy/1-carbon-pricing.qmd#extra-the-right-policy-at-the-wrong-time) (book)

### [2. Other Tax and Fiscal Policy](../policy/2-other-tax.qmd)

Tax rent, not effort: land and corporate taxes that hold up when capital and people can move.

- [2.1 Taxing Rent, Not Effort](../policy/2-other-tax/RentTax/index.qmd)
- [2.2 Let Land Pay for the City](../policy/2-other-tax/LandPaysForTheCity/index.qmd)

### [3. Finance and Risk](../policy/3-finance-and-risk.qmd)

Make clean power an asset class: remove payment risk at source, then turn projects into standard securities.

- [3.1 Guarantee the Contract, Not the Debt](../policy/3-finance-and-risk/ClimateFinanceIntermediationForCleanPower/index.qmd)
- [3.2 From Projects to Asset Classes](../policy/3-finance-and-risk/CleanPowerAssetClasses/index.qmd)
- [Time and Chance](../policy/3-finance-and-risk.qmd#extra-time-and-chance) (book)

### [4. Sovereign Incentives](../policy/4-sovereign-incentives.qmd)

Reward governments, not projects: guarantee capacity and held capital that pay for acting early.

- [4.1 Reward the Stock as Well as the Flow](../policy/4-sovereign-incentives/NotionalCapitalisedValueAndGuarantees/index.qmd)
- [4.2 The Climate Investment Trust](../policy/4-sovereign-incentives/ClimateInvestmentTrust/index.qmd)
- [4.3 Codify Sustainability-Linked Sovereign Lending, Then Give It Scale](../policy/4-sovereign-incentives/SustainabilityLinkedLending/index.qmd)
